verdict.rationale: The docs describe a managed connector framework covering 400+ services with one-click OAuth, name specific integrations (Gmail, Outlook, GitHub, Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Snowflake, Salesforce), and show connectors being authenticated mid-task. That covers the 'add them' half of the story. Nothing shows a browsable directory or marketplace where a user discovers third-party apps, and the claims appear only on the MCP-server docs page. Missing for 10: evidence of a browsable connector directory or marketplace UI, user-added custom or third-party apps beyond the managed list, dedicated connector documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
